mcpUi.title: MCP servers
mcpUi.hint: Manage saved servers and current connection status. Adding a server runs a local command. Only connect services you trust.
mcpUi.readFailed: Could not read MCP servers. The list may be out of date. Retry or check your local MCP configuration.
mcpUi.builtin: Built-in service. Manage it with the Browser automation (Playwright) toggle on the Tools page.
mcpUi.empty: No MCP servers added. Use the ＋ button above to add one.
mcpUi.commandPrompt: Enter a startup command (e.g. node path/to/server.js) or a remote server address (e.g. https://example.com/mcp). Shell pipes and redirection are not supported.
mcpUi.namePrompt: Give this MCP server a display name.
mcpUi.connectTitle: Connect to a remote MCP server?
mcpUi.connectMessage:
Firefly will connect to this remote MCP server. Its tools send their arguments to this address, so verify that you trust it. A successful connection is saved and reconnects when the app starts.

{{url}}
mcpUi.runMessage:
This local command will run. The service may access local files and the network. Verify that you trust its source. A successful connection is saved and reconnects when the app starts.

{{command}}
mcpUi.addFailedMessage: Connection or saving failed. Check the command, MCP service and local configuration, then retry. Error details are hidden because they may contain credentials.
mcpUi.removeMessage: Deleting “{{name}}” disconnects it, removes its tools and deletes its saved configuration. You will need to add it again to use it. Continue?
mcpUi.removeFailedMessage: Disconnection or saving failed. Refresh the status and retry. The saved configuration may remain even if the connection has closed.
mcpUi.enableFailedMessage: Connection or saving did not finish; the server is unchanged.
mcpUi.enableFailedWhy: Could not enable: {{reason}}. The server is unchanged.
mcpUi.disableFailedMessage: Disconnection or saving did not finish. Refresh the status and retry.
mcpUi.addFailedWhy: Could not add the server: {{reason}}. Check the command and local configuration, then retry. Error details are hidden because they may contain credentials.

desktopAsr.projectLanguage: Recognition language follows your Aliyun project configuration.
desktopAsr.title: ASR settings
desktopAsr.hint: The microphone starts only when you click Dictate. Audio goes to your selected provider; transcription only fills the draft and is never sent automatically. Each recording lasts up to about 110 seconds.
desktopAsr.localUnavailable: Local recognition is not implemented. Choose another provider.
desktopAsr.mosslandHint: Audio is uploaded after stopping, then returned as complete text. Cancelling before Stop does not upload it.
desktopAsr.aliyunHint: Audio streams to Aliyun during recording. Cancellation stops sending but cannot retract audio already sent.
desktopAsr.shared: Enabled channels also use this configuration for audio transcription. Turning it off preserves saved credentials.
desktopAsr.loadFailed: Loading failed. Reopen settings and retry.

usage.title: Usage
usage.hint: See where tokens go by model and feature, which conversations cost the most, and how often messages, skills and plugins are used. Data stays on this device.
usage.empty: No usage recorded in this period.
usage.featureNote: Usage by feature is recorded from this version on; earlier usage is shown as “Before tracking”.
usage.clearMessage: All usage records on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
usage.unavailable: Usage data is not available in this window.
usage.loadFailed: Could not read usage. Please try again.

subagents.title: Sub-agents
subagents.hint: All 12 specialist sub-agents, side by side. Each one can inherit the main model or use its own model profile.

agentRouting.notice: Every role follows the default model; pick another model in a role's list when that role should use something else. Changing the bound profile ID does not migrate existing Agent sessions; editing a profile affects sessions using it.
agentRouting.sourceDescription: Default route: {{route}}; Role selection: {{selected}}; Effective profile: {{effective}}
agentRouting.unconfiguredRefused: No default model yet · execution will be refused

providerUi.savedWithChanges: Submitted version saved. Newer changes are still unsaved.
providerUi.emptyTitle: Select or add a model configuration
providerUi.emptyHint: Choose a saved configuration from the list, or add a model provider to get started.
providerUi.discardMessage: Switching will discard unsaved changes to this model profile.
providerUi.listSubtitle: Each configuration uses one model. Status describes saved configuration only.
providerUi.presetHint: Pick DeepSeek, Kimi, Claude or another built-in provider and enter its API key to use it.

inputModalities.label: Input types
inputModalities.hint: Auto follows the input types the vendor's model list reports, then the built-in catalog; with neither, the model is treated as text only. Choose Image or Text only to override.
inputModalities.sourceUnknown: not recognized (set Image manually if it accepts images)

channels.publicHint: These settings apply to every channel.
channels.appDesc: After pairing, chat with Firefly and get reminders on your phone.

memory.heading: Firefly Memory

overview.title: Memory overview

overview.coverageValue: {{present}} of {{population}} present, {{missing}} missing, {{unknownDenied}} unknown or denied

entries.title: My memories
entries.desc: Review what Firefly remembers. You can edit, forget, or confirm pending items.
entries.referenceNeedsRestatement: Please restate the preference you want remembered in chat, or reject this record.

source.failed: Failed to load the source. Please retry.

entries.emptyAll: Nothing has been remembered yet. Firefly picks out long-term details from your chats.
entries.backendDown: The memory service is unavailable, so memories cannot be shown.
entries.loadFailed: Failed to read memories. Please retry.

reason.revision: This item was just updated. The list has been refreshed, please try again.
reason.notFound: This item no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
reason.secret: This text contains sensitive information and cannot be saved.

shadow.title: Shadow extraction (experimental)
shadow.desc: A model picks out preferences from your chats that may be worth remembering and keeps them in a separate local record, only to measure accuracy. They never enter your memory and are never used in answers.
shadow.privacySaved: Health, finance, ID, address, contact details and facts about other people are not saved.
shadow.privacySent: However, the full text of each of your messages (and the reply right before it) is sent once more to your current model provider, which may cost extra. Only obvious keys and passwords are not sent.
shadow.enableHint: Off by default. When on, each successful chat reply triggers one extra request to the model used in that chat.
shadow.confirmBody: Your chat messages will be sent an extra time to your current model provider, which may cost extra. You can turn it off any time.
shadow.capHint: The most extra requests per day (1 to 1000). No more requests that day once it is reached; it also stops for the day if your quota runs out or you are rate limited.
shadow.capInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
shadow.statusQuota: Stopped for today: quota exhausted; resumes tomorrow
shadow.statusRate: Stopped for today: rate limited; resumes tomorrow
shadow.detailValue: {{skipped}} not sent · {{errors}} failed · {{cancelled}} cancelled · {{dropped}} dropped by checks
shadow.clearBody: All shadow records are deleted permanently right away. The call count for today is not reset.
shadow.disabledDone: Turned off; requests in progress were canceled.
shadow.unavailable: The memory service in this version does not support shadow extraction.
shadow.loadFailed: Could not load. Please try again.

error.SHADOW_UNAVAILABLE: The memory service in this version does not support shadow extraction.
error.SHADOW_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
error.SHADOW_INPUT_INVALID: Invalid input. Please check and try again.
error.SHADOW_REVISION_CONFLICT: The setting just changed and was refreshed. Please try again.
error.SHADOW_FAILED: The action did not finish. Please try again later.

imported.title: Imported knowledge
imported.desc: Documents uploaded in the chat window are indexed, and Firefly refers to them when answering.
imported.emptyHint: Upload a file in the chat window and it is indexed automatically
imported.unavailable: The imported knowledge interface is unavailable
imported.loadFailed: Failed to read imported knowledge. Please retry

automation.title: Save preferences automatically
automation.desc: Off by default. Only explicit, lasting preferences for Chinese or English and concise or detailed replies can be remembered automatically. Conflicts and other candidates still need your confirmation. Temporary chats are excluded. Turning this off keeps existing memories; forget them below.
automation.stale: Settings changed and were refreshed. Please select again.
automation.failed: Could not save. Settings were refreshed.
automation.budget: Preference extraction requests today: {{used}} / 20. With automatic saving off, new candidates still need confirmation; extraction remains limited per day.
automation.unknown: Some requests have no known result and will not be retried automatically.

graph.label: Memory graph
graph.hint: Pick a node to see and manage it below. Drag nodes or the background to move, scroll to zoom.
graph.empty: Nothing remembered yet. Preferences you state in a chat appear here once confirmed.

enabled.title: Enable custom colors
enabled.desc: Set the accent, background and foreground colors. Changes save automatically and apply to all windows.

user.heading: My Info

account.signedOutDesc: Sign in to sync your profile and settings across devices (coming soon).

user.nicknameDesc: If the call preference is empty, Firefly calls you by your nickname.
user.genderDesc: Optional. If you choose Prefer not to say, Firefly does not record this.
user.callPrefDesc: Firefly uses this name first when addressing you.
user.birthdayDesc: Optional. Firefly keeps it in your personal info.
user.cityDesc: Used by location-based tools such as weather when no city is given.
user.timezoneDesc: Only used for time calculations; it does not indicate your city.
user.fieldHint: The call preference takes priority over the nickname; if both are empty, Firefly calls you Pioneer. The default city is used by location-based tools such as weather; the time zone is only used for time calculations and does not indicate your city.

nav.generalHint: Choose Firefly's interface language. Changes are saved immediately.
